pkgmetadata.longdescription: camofox-browser is an anti-detection browser automation server for AI agents. It exposes a REST API that wraps the Camoufox stealth browser engine — a Firefox fork with C++-level fingerprint spoofing — driven through camoufox-js and playwright-core. This binary package installs the Node.js application together with a pinned, hash-verified Camoufox browser bundle, so no browser download happens at runtime.
